title: R2-D2
description: After the return of Emperor Palpatine, R2-D2 stayed by General Leia Organa's side at the Resistance base on Ajan Kloss. He had witnessed Leia's birth and was also by her side when she died. When their allies returned with C-3PO having sacrificed his memories to translate Sith runes, R2-D2 was ready with a backup for his best friend. During the Battle of Exegol, R2-D2 flew with Poe as his Astromech Droid.
